overloads.semanticRole: Creates or replaces the first-level items of a hierarchical list or choice list from the elements of array, optionally assigning explicit per-item reference numbers via itemRefs.

constraints: Only sets first-level items of the target list; nested/sub-items are not addressable via this command.
If list is a numeric ListRef (hierarchical list), that list must already have been created previously (e.g. via New list) -- this command cannot create a new hierarchical list from scratch.

If list is a Text choice-list name, this command modifies the structure file, so any local edits are lost on next structure-file update in production, and it cannot be used against a read-only structure (a .4dz project, including remote projects, or a component).
If itemRefs is omitted, 4D automatically assigns list item reference numbers 1, 2, ... N.
